thread:
Ben Carter: seeing a huge burst of 5xx from api-gateway in the last 3m, PD is firing. I’m getting multiple duplicate pages right now. Anyone on rotation can pick this up?
PagerDuty Bot: Incident created INC-2026-07-01-APIGW (triggered by api-gateway-error > threshold) — responders: @oncall-sre, @maya.singh
Maya Singh: I’m on it, jumping in. First check: are we seeing a backend flake or a rollout?
Lars Johansen: checking deploys — nothing in the last 30m. Looking at backend pods, CPU and mem look fine.
Ben Carter: logs show upstream 502/504 from model-proxy; connection resets. Might be transient overload.
InfraBot: Alert: api-gateway 5xx rate exceeded: 120/min aggregated. Query: sum(rate(http_responses{code=~"5..",service="api-gateway"}[1m])) by (service) = 2.0e+02
Maya Singh: ok, PD noise is the immediate problem. I’m going to temporarily dampen PD routing for this alert while we mitigate so paging stops spamming.
Maya Singh: action: add a temporary dampener rule to route alert -> "noise" for 10m. Will post commands.
Heather Wu: +1 please also spike the alert grouping window so similar bursts batch together.
Ben Carter: can we add a short-term rate cap on PD for this alert: limit one PD notification per minute per service?
Lars Johansen: making a small change to the alert rule now — increasing sliding window and adding a dedupe label. Current rule: 
```
alert: ApiGatewayHigh5xx
expr: sum(rate(http_responses{code=~"5..",service="api-gateway"}[1m])) > 50
for: 0m
labels: {severity="page"}
```
Proposed tweak for live mitigation: 
```
expr: sum(rate(http_responses{code=~"5..",service="api-gateway"}[3m])) > 100
for: 1m
labels: {severity="warning", dedupe_key="service"}
```
Maya Singh: applied temporary rule, added a 10m PD suppressor and increased grouping. PD will still create an incident but only first alert will page.
PagerDuty Bot: Suppressor active for ApiGatewayHigh5xx until 2026-07-01T09:30:00Z — reroute notifications to #eng-oncall-noise (no pages).
Ben Carter: thanks. Now focus on root cause — model-proxy is showing connection pool exhaustion. I’ll add capacity and restart one replica to drain.
Lars Johansen: scaling model-proxy replicas +2 now. Also bump connection timeout config to 45s in staging and will roll to prod canary.
Heather Wu: added a temporary dashboard panel: 1) 5xx rate (1m/3m), 2) model-proxy pool utilization, 3) upstream latency. Link: https://grafana.company/net/board/apigw-burst
Maya Singh: observed 5xx rate dropping after scale + config change. Still seeing a tail of errors — keeping suppressor on for 5 more mins.
Ben Carter: can we add a short-term alert dedupe at the routing layer too? If the same error signature repeats within 30s, fold into the same PD incident.
Lars Johansen: filed a routing change PR: add in-flight dedupe key = sha256(service+status+upstream) with 30s window. Will request review from @heather.
Heather Wu: reviewing now. Also recommending a follow-up to convert this temporary change into a permanent burst-dampening policy for api-gateway with a beta flag.
Maya Singh: customer impact check: checked top queries and flags — ~0.7% of requests failing in peak 09:12-09:18. No major customers reported errors via support. Marking impact low-medium.
Ben Carter: created follow-up ticket INF-420: "Permanent burst-dampening for api-gateway alerts + PD ratecap" — includes tasks: 1) route-level dedupe, 2) routing rate-limit config, 3) dashboard refinement, 4) unit tests for dedupe key.
Maya Singh: adding owners: Lars (implementation), Heather (dashboard + routing tests), Ben (post-incident review).
Ben Carter: handing off to @oncall-bot for the 09:30->10:30 shift. Keep suppressor until 09:30 as planned.
oncall-bot: Handoff acknowledged. Next oncall: Maya Singh (09:30 UTC). Summary pinned to thread.
Maya Singh: I’ll run the post-incident tuning tomorrow morning: tighten grouping, keep longer for burst windows, and add a rate limiter at the alert-router level (1 page/min per service with exponential backoff).
Heather Wu: also proposing we add a dashboard alert to catch connection pool exhaustion earlier so we can preempt scale.
Lars Johansen: noted. I’ll include that metric in the rollout PR.
Ben Carter: final notes — we avoided major customer impact, PD noise reduced with temporary dampen/ratecap, next steps are infra ticket + permanent router rule + dashboard additions + runbook update.
Maya Singh: marking thread resolved for live paging; leaving the follow-ups in INF-420. Will report back after PR merges. :white_check_mark:
PagerDuty Bot: Incident INC-2026-07-01-APIGW status changed to monitored (no active pages).
